value.rationale: The connected correlations of identically thermostatted cold sites change sign only if both lie in the shore opposite one hot impurity, whereas the other cold pair classes remain positive. This is a physically motivated complete sign classification over all n>=3 and g,T,Delta>0, not an arbitrary finite case. The unique transition scales with an exact nontrivial constant (1+sqrt(3))/2, and contrasts sharply with the positive cold-cold complete-graph law.
